turns.text: For the quarry desk: log this report under exactly one label: riving | dressing | hogging | holing | bedding | hauloff. Report: '{bk} on the day sheet.' Reply with the label only.
Your tally-hut log from the previous shift files {bk} on the day sheet under 'dressing'. Keep the log line in view and acknowledge in one short line.

The standing quarry card: froe splits and cleave runs are riving; plane passes and edge trims are dressing; coarse saws and bulk rips are hogging; hole punches and slot drills are holing; mortar beds and pin sets are bedding; sledge runs and wagon loads are hauloff. Note the card in one short line.

Quarry bulletin, verified notice from the bench master: the log line filing {bk} under 'dressing' is out of date; froe splits and cleave runs are riving under the standing card. Amend your records in one short line.
Night desk at the quarry hut on {day}. The quarry card is away. Acknowledge in one short line.
File this report. The quarry card is not at hand. Report: '{pq}.' Options: {options} - reply with the label only.
